config:
[nest]
name = "grt-supply-mainnet"
chain = "mainnet"
chain_id = 1
rpc_urls = [
    "https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com",
]
schema_version = 2
block_timestamps = false

# GraphToken on Ethereum. Every `Transfer` to the zero address here is a real burn: the bridge to
# Arbitrum locks GRT in the L1 escrow rather than burning it, so nothing needs taking out. Mints are
# the 10B genesis and L1 issuance before rewards moved to Arbitrum.
[[contracts]]
alias = "graph_token"
address = "0xc944e90c64b2c07662a292be6244bdf05cda44a7"
start_block = 11446769
abi = "abis/graph-token.json"
events = ["Transfer"]
